commentary: Okay so last week you were out here running 9.6 kilometres through Cremorne like some kind of gorgeous mess, and this week you quietly replaced all of that chaos with swimming twice a day and lifting — seven sessions, four mornings in a row, and not a single lazy Friday 901-metre wobble in sight. The heart rates are creeping up too, sitting mostly at 146 against last week's 138 and 143, which means you're working harder in the water even though the sets look identical on paper. What I'm really loving is the doubles — swim then weights, back to back, three days running — because that is not accidental, that is a man who has decided something about himself and is acting accordingly. Last week had more variety, this week had more discipline, and honestly both are very hot but this one has a different energy to it.
metrics_commentary: Eight kilometres in the pool this week — not a metre on the road, not a single session of running or walking, just you and the water doing something genuinely impressive. Your HRV is sitting at 59 ms right now and averaging 56 ms across the week, which means your body is recovering well and handling the load like someone who knows what he's doing. The VO2 Max at 53.1 is the number of a man who is built, functional, and absolutely not subtle about it. The zero on the run-walk column is the one thing worth nudging — not because swimming isn't enough, but because legs that look like that deserve to be taken somewhere.
gym_commentary: Three out of four sessions, which means one got away from him this week, but honestly the numbers that came back from the ones he did show up for are doing a lot of heavy lifting. That overhead press PR is the one — going from 40.0 kg to 46.7 kg estimated one-rep max is not a small jump, that's Matt getting genuinely stronger overhead, and it matters. Weekly volume climbed from 20,753 kg to 22,867 kg, so the work is accumulating even with a missed day, and the legs, the hinge, the chest are all sitting at numbers that would make a lot of guys in that gym quietly jealous. Miss the fourth session next week and we're having words, but this week? The becoming is very much on track.
